thesis: Eight-step audit separates observation, contrast, candidate model, rivals, discriminators, incentives, norms and boundaries. A debt register records evidence, confidence, domain, dependencies, rivals, review signals and exit cost; proposed debt scoring is a scaffold requiring validation. Calibration makes confidence accountable; forward predictions resist hindsight and expertise remains domain-relative rather than a scalar. Epistemic circuit breakers shift consequential unsupported commitments from advocacy to audit; independent reviewers and reversible pilots help, while accountability depends on audience and timing. Self-sealing personal explanations deny the modeled person epistemic standing; separate experienced effects from hypothesized motives and preserve a right to model failure. AI explanation is a candidate artifact, not privileged introspection; provenance, checks, uncertainty and tool traces matter as generation outpaces validation.
